title: Pay reserved inflation and use only earned auxiliary recurrence
statement: The accepted repaired audit supplies primal bulk V=product factorial^alpha with LV/V<=-c sum_y(x)_y in the same all-high region, plus the one-count right inverse and neutral solve Q_II u=-1-Q_IO1. Polynomial multipliers require reserved envelope inflation. Earned auxiliary recurrence, finite-head occupation, strong Markov and stopped Dynkin/localization/Fatou give K_J V<=V+C and E tau_exit<=C-prime(V+1). For NONNEGATIVE exit data g<=cV, H_g is finite and nonnegative harmonic; it is strictly positive only with additional reachable positive exit data (g=0 is a counterexample). Running costs dominated by the earned drift integrand give finite Poisson transfers. No neighboring-corner contraction, arbitrary signed data, growing halo uniformity or physical global recurrence is proved.
